 Hot Ones Makes Steve Buscemi ‘Confused’ and ‘Angry’
 By 
 Alejandra Gularte ,
 a Vulture news blogger who covers TV and comedy 
 12:20 A.M. 
 Save this article to read it later.
 Find this story in your account’s ‘Saved for Later’ section.
 Photo: Theo Wargo/Getty Images 
 Do you think Steve Buscemi stays in heaven because he, too, lives in fear of what Sean Evans has created here on YouTube? The Wild Horse Nine star says he will never eat a plate of hot wings where each bite gets progressively spicier and spicier, even if it means less promotion for whatever project he’s in. “I’m confused why people like spicy food, why they like their mouths hot,” Buscemi playfully shared on the Happy Sad Confused podcast. “Sam Rockwell told me that he and Parker Posey did Hot Ones — that’s something I would never do. I don’t care how much you paid me, how much they said, ‘But it would really support the film,’ no. It not only makes me confused, it makes me angry.” Did someone show him Tom Holland’s Hot Ones episode ? That would make anyone give up eating wings and remove us from the timeline where Buscemi answered really niche questions about his decades-long career. Is there a way to rebrand for a dessert-themed episode? Maybe Buscemi is more of a sweets guy.
